title: Doctors struggle to save babies after parents refuse vitamin K
summary: Doctors are fighting an uphill battle against disinformation about routine vitamin K shots given to newborns in the hospital. It helps prevent a rare but devastating bleeding disorder.

title: The human cost of the electric vehicle boom is at the center of a lawsuit in Congo
summary: A landmark lawsuit in Congo sees 27 residents accuse a Chinese-owned copper and cobalt mine of poisoning their community and the government of failing to protect them.
content: A landmark lawsuit in Congo sees 27 residents accuse a Chinese-owned copper and cobalt mine of poisoning their community and the government of failing to protect them. (Image credit: Marie Ruwet)

title: This group of seamstresses mends shirts to make chemo easier for cancer patients
summary: Seamstresses in Ohio and other states are making zippered shirts for cancer patients so they can more comfortably undergo chemotherapy treatments.

title: Here's the public health guidance for possible lead exposure in Iowa
